node.title: L1 exact-shell prefix/Hankel bridge
node.statement: For every received word U and every exact agreement size a>k, the exact first-match zero shell E_a(U) of the a-support interpolation-prefix map is in bijection with degree-below-k codewords having exact agreement a, and #ImgFib_U(s)=sum_(a>=s)#E_a(U). In any admissible sunflower source, fixing missed core D and noncore support X identifies the global depth-(a-k) prefix zero condition unitriangularly with the existing saturated Hankel condition T_(X,d)(L_D)=0, including both exactness guards. Thus L1 may close either by row-sharp Q for primitive received-word exact shells with quotient shells paid separately, or by direct fixed-source Hankel aggregation. Toy power-sum Q and the special F2 Myerson statement do not transfer without an explicit chart theorem.
